name: Curly-cup Gumweed
desc: Curly-cup Gumweed (Grindelia squarrosa): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 105 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Grindelia squarrosa, also known as a curly-top gumweed or curlycup gumweed, is a small North American biennial or short-lived perennial plant.
